FY 2024-25 Details of improvements in environmental and social impacts

R&D - - - Capex 0.21% - During the financial year, the Company undertook various sustainability- focused infrastructure improvements aimed at enhancing environmental performance and resource efficiency. These initiatives included installation of the OGT system in STP plant, installation of SVG units for improving power factor and reducing energy losses, strengthening of electrical systems, deployment of radar lighting systems, and enhancement of HVAC infrastructure through installation of energy- efficient pumps, cooling towers, and chillers. These measures have contributed towards improved energy efficiency, optimized resource utilization, reduced environmental impact, and overall strengthening of the Company’s sustainability practices.
